# Joseph and Aseneth Chapter 24 — Disagreement Log
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Date:** 2026-03-17

---

## 24:4 — did not turn aside to the right hand or the left

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "did not turn aside to the right hand or the left" | Literal — biblical idiom |
| LOGOS | "did not turn aside to the right or to the left" | Standard version of the idiom |
| PNEUMA | "never turned aside, right or left" | Compressed |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** LOGOS is adopted. The idiom 'to the right or to the left' (cf. Deut 5:32) is well established in biblical style. EMET's 'right hand' is slightly redundant; PNEUMA's compression loses the idiomatic form. Adopted LOGOS.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---
